headline: Public hearing on a Class B victualler license for Isla Express at 584 Smithfield Avenue, plus event license petitions.
summary: The meeting includes a public hearing on a new Class B victualler license for Isla Express. It also covers a new victualling house license and several event license petitions.
items: Victualling House First Class New license for Providence Express (Providence Express Inc.), 756 East Ave., LIC#VIC-26-23

Entertainment and Class F (Beer & Wine) license for Burbage Theatre Company's Big Time Celebration – Fundraising Gala at 59 Blackstone Avenue, Monday, October 26, 2026, 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m., LIC#EVT-26-88

Entertainment and Class F-1 (Full Privilege) license for Burbage Theatre Company's Second Annual Little Mx. Burbage Halloqween Drag Night at 59 Blackstone Avenue, Saturday, October 31, 2026, 9:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m., LIC#EVT-26-90

Entertainment and one-day expansion of premise for German American Cultural Society of RI, 78 Carter Avenue, indoor and outdoor Christmas Market and outdoor alcoholic beverage service, Saturday, November 28, 2026, 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., LIC#EVT-26-91

Entertainment and one-day expansion of premise for Societe Jacques Cartier Cercle No. 4, Jacques Cartier Corn Hole Tournament at 816 Main Street (outdoors), Saturday, October 24, 2026, 11:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., LIC#EVT-26-89
Public hearing on Class B (Victualler) New license for Isla Express (Isla Express LLC), 584 Smithfield Avenue, LIC#LQB-26-9®, previously 20/20 Hookah Lounge
